Founder Control GatesLink

GatePass StandardIf Not Passed
Pricing qualityPricing governance supports quote, concession, margin, expiry, and recovery logic.Keep offer confidence from widening.
Trust qualityCustomer or supplier trust posture supports the release, credit, sourcing, or dependence being requested.Keep movement controlled and refresh trust posture.
Cash qualityCollections, cash outlook, funding, credit, and release records carry one answer.Block release acceleration, supplier reservation, or payment movement.
Supplier qualitySupplier approval, performance, capacity, backup coverage, and compliance proof support the planned demand.Hold volume, sourcing dependence, or customer commitment.
Forecast qualityRevenue band matches the real proof state instead of aspiration, weighted hope, or stretch logic.Keep the path in lead, weighted, stretch, or active watch posture.
Owner qualityThe next action has a named owner, deadline, evidence route, and escalation standard.Route to the founder execution queue before approving movement.

Protection and Escalation RulesLink

TriggerRequired ActionFounder Protection
A lead, weighted path, or stretch path starts behaving like a live dealKeep it outside active posture until source evidence supports promotion.Prevents forecast optimism from becoming hidden commitment.
A customer request widens release, credit, pricing, or growth exposureRoute through customer room, credit release, trust posture, pricing governance, and cash controls.Keeps relationship momentum from outrunning proof.
Supplier dependence widens while approval, performance, backup, or compliance proof remains incompleteHold supplier posture at controlled and refresh supplier approval plus supply resilience.Prevents sourcing confidence from outrunning resilience.
A won deal is reused as precedent before execution proof and profitability are retainedRefresh won room, trade review, release proof, and archive path before reuse.Keeps reference wins proof-backed.
Founder asks for movement but owner, deadline, or evidence route is unclearRoute to founder execution queue and owner accountability before approving.Prevents work from moving on memory.
CRM notes start carrying protected template, brand, or final-doc contentMove live work to the owned room and preserve protected masters.Maintains template and brand protections.
